lines.en: The party begins the way it always begins — at the beginning! But is the beginning the end this time? Find out soon! Halloween!
: Well, we made it! Sure, there was a little drama along the way. And sure, we’re a tiny bit fashionably late at this point...but we’re here! And that’s more than Ami and Maya can say.
: Should we maybe...call Ami and see if...she was ever able to find Maya? Or are we just...ignoring their existence for the rest of the night?...

: What do you think, Sensei? Should we let the two of them have whatever sort of emotional moment they’re having behind the scenes to themselves? Or is it time to finally check in and see if they’re okay?
: Darn it. We’ve lost him again.
: I’d say he looks upset but...I think that’s just his default expression...
: I’m still here, you two. And it doesn’t really matter to me whether or not one of them is okay. I’m just worried about whether Ami is going to make it here or not.
: But if she does, then you’ll just swap to being worried about how she is here. Also, that’s mean to Maya. Even if she isn’t our Maya.
: Is there...a second Maya?...
: There used to be. She went on vacation to a different time-
: Is there...a second Maya?...
: Some stuff happened with the end of the world where-
: Is there...a second Maya?...
: There’s probably even more than that when you factor in how time itself keeps being-
: Is there...a second Maya?...
: Ayane, knock it off. You’re going to break Sana.
: What?...
: It’s just so weird. I keep feeling like we already talked to her about this stuff, but I have no idea how since she keeps turning into a robot any time I try.
: Or maybe she is a robot and it’s not Sana beneath that mask at all! Show yourself, you coward!

And so begins another Halloween...but to say I’m at all excited about that would be nothing short of the greatest lie ever told since the last one marked the real end of the world as far as I’m concerned.
Everything that has happened since then has felt like some sort of tragic epilogue designed to drag me through the mud and beat me until I can no longer move.
It’s worked too. Which is why I find myself struggling to redirect my blood flow the way I always do when I walk into a room full of girls in cosplay.
Can I find it in myself to actually have fun this year, though?
Because seeing Maya like that earlier, even if she wasn’t Maya, has undoubtedly made it harder for me to keep my head on straight today.
So the question now is whether I will be able to look past that toward shades of the older me.
I can picture it when I close my eyes. I’m not smiling, but I’m present. And that’s far more than whatever I am now. Because at least there were others around back then to make up for what I lack.
And yes, those people still exist today. But I’ve already stolen everything from everyone and there’s just...nothing left for me to fill the void with anymore.
So I ask myself again — can I really do this?
Can I ignore the past and live in the present- even if it’s just for one night?
: And there he is! Welcome back to the land of the living, Master!
The answer is no. No I can not.
: Hey, Uta. Hey...Io.
: Hi...Sensei.
: A few of us were beginning to worry you were gonna back outta the party this year. Which would’ve been a real disaster since we’ve all been dying to see you.
: Yeah, well...it’s nice being back.
The second greatest lie ever told.
: Don’t think that means I’m planning on coming back to school yet, though. I need...a lot more time before I even consider something like that.
: You mean you’re just gonna let Ami come back to school without supervision? You sure that’s safe for...literally anybody?
: Why did you immediately start blushing after mentioning Ami’s name?
: Don’t worry about it. That’s probably going to happen for a while.
: F...Forget about Ami! Io! Don’t you wanna express a little more excitement now that Sensei’s coming to our parties again? He was like 50%% of the reason you ever bothered showing up, wasn’t he?
: Yeah...I’m...glad he’s...you’re back.
: That’s...exciting.
: I feel like you’re normally a little more enthusiastic than that...
: Sensei! Sana and I are gonna go sit down. But we’ll let you know if we hear anything from Ami.
: Huh? Oh, yeah. Okay. Cool.
I’m abandoned by my chaperones — two of the only girls in this room who do a consistent job of making me feel human (even if one of them is still new to the trade).
But of course that leaves me with two who don’t.
There’s one who accentuates everything evil within me. One who I have seen in ways that aren’t meant to be seen. Who I think about when I’m at my highest and lowest.
And another — who I struggle to see at all after our last meeting.
: So, what’s the plan for today? Gonna walk around and do some of that good ole’ Sensei mingling you always do at these things? We should probably start bringing a sign-up sheet for that, shouldn’t-
: Uta, I’m really sorry to interrupt. But would it be okay if I talked to Sensei alone for a minute?
: Huh? Yeah, of course. It’s not like I own him. It’s probably closer to the other way around after all of the money he’s given me. Is everything okay, though?
: No. Not really. But nothing’s ever really okay and in order to stop everything from becoming even more terrible, I sort of have to talk to him. Alone. Now.
: Uh...Do you...need any of your...medicine? Because my bag is-
: We’ll see...
: Sensei...I know it’s probably exhausting already being dragged into my bullshit five seconds after you showed up, but-
: It’s fine...
: Okay...sorry.
: I think there’s a room over there we can-
: Aaaand the winner is Io. Good game, everyone. See you next holiday.
: Uh...winner?
: Yeah. Every single party, there’s always one girl who gets to spend alone time with Sensei first.
: So I decided to turn it into a game in order to cope with the fact that there will always be other girls fighting for him and that his heart will never truly belong to me no matter what I do.
: But hey! You also love him now so that just means you get to play too!
: Why not just...take first place yourself then?
: Because there are designated times where I’m allowed to be selfish and this is not one of them. Duh.
: So...do you think they’re, like...you know...
: Mmmmm...no. But I am not willing to divulge why I think that. I guess something could have changed, though. But to the point where it’s happening five seconds into a party? Nah. Not yet.
: Oh well. At least now you know about the game and can start racking up points of your own. You’ve been getting more bold lately, so there’s still a good chance you can catch up.
: Ayane...how are you...this good at dealing with jealousy?
: It’s not like I want to be. I’m just used to it. And the sad truth is that you’re going to get used to it too the longer you stay with him. But as long as you’re not doing anything rash-
: I broke a glass and gave him a blowjob at the bar when he came in with Miss Imai the other night.
: I think I have a problem, Ayane.
: I think I want to pretend I didn’t just hear that.
: I don’t even think he wanted one.
: Why are you still talking about this?
: He didn’t even cum that much.
: Sana, stop! You’re ruining your appeal!
: Sorry, I just...don’t have anyone else to talk to about this...
: That’s fine! But that doesn’t mean you need to start providing the specific details of how much he cums when you give him spontaneous blowjobs!
: But what if he does it more for other girls? I’m not as good with jealousy as you are...
: N-New subject! How have things been apart from your quest for Sensei lately? Has business at the bar picked back up? Did you finish all of your math homework?
: No. But I had a really intense daydream about my brother the other night.
: Intense...how? And please tell me it won’t further tarnish your image.

: He tried to give me a tour of a liminal space but wasn’t ever able to because I pulled all of the knives out of him. Then he turned into Sensei as a kid and Kaori showed up. Also, I think God was there.
: What did Sensei look like as a kid? I must know.
: Very cute. Maybe even a little feminine. I tried flirting with him but it didn’t work.
: I don’t blame you. I would have done the same thing.
: Your brother, though? That’s weird for you, isn’t it? I didn’t realize he ever showed up in your dreams.
: That’s why it was weird...It just kind of...happened out of nowhere. Like, I was walking home and...all of a sudden, there was a...thing that tickled trees and...Sensei could fly and...
: I’ve been seeing all sorts of weird things lately, Ayane. I’m starting to think I’m going insane.
: By any chance, did you see a strange creature with a giant penis and a red shirt that called himself “Big Boi?”
: No, but I wouldn’t rule out that he’ll show up at some point since I guess this is just my life now.
: Well, if you do, let me know...Because I’ve been seeing a lot of weird things too. So it takes a lot more than that for me to think someone is crazy nowadays.
: Maybe we’re...both going crazy?
: Or maybe it’s the world we live-
: Maybe we’re...both going crazy?
: Damn it! That too?! I barely even said anything!
: Wh-Why are you yelling at me?! I barely said anything either!
: I know! That’s the whole problem! There’s a bunch of stuff I want to tell you but literally can’t because of extenuating circumstances that-
: Wh-Why are you yelling at me?! I barely said anything either!
: ARGGGGGGHH!!!!!!!
They were entirely sane, they were mad and delusional, they were the best of friends, they were mortal enemies, they were immeasurably happy, they were deeply depressed.
But more than all of that...they were-
Empty hearts are hard to break. That’s something I have learned-
On walks down to my mother’s lake. Mistakes are made, not earned.
Through joy and pleasure, wind and rain, this fear of something new-
I won’t ever see the point of pain, nor love received from you.
Of all the rooms in this infinite house, this is the one she chooses.
She knows not its significance, nor the way it makes me feel. She knows nothing of the pain or dread that accompanies that orange glow or how it paints her in a way that accentuates her cracks.
She knows nothing at all.
She looks like me in the light.
: So, I’ve...had time to think about what happened, and...
: I want you to know I...
: I don’t blame you, Sensei...
: If you...even feel bad about it, I mean. Which you might not. I know you’ve said before that that’s just...how you love. And that...makes me really happy. Or...happy-ish, I guess.
: Maybe more...bittersweet than anything. Like, I want to drown in the mere thought that someone like me could ever mean so much to you, but there’s something about it I just...don’t really get.
: And that’s a me thing. It’s always been a me thing. And I’m not good when it comes to, like...sacrificing stuff, you know?
: I have so little that the few things I do have, I can’t help but cling to for dear life because I don’t want to ever be completely alone.
: Is that what you’re doing now then?
: Yeah...it is. It’s what I did back in my room too.

: I thought that just escaping from my old home would make it so I could finally have my own body for once, but...not sharing it with someone you’re falling in love with does nothing but break the fall.
: So you can have it...whenever you want. Even now if you feel like it. And I’ll try not to be so...impatient this time.
: I just...want to ask for something selfish in return. I want you to really fall for me. Like...hard.
: I want to finish school, break down that stupid fucking wall, and build a house with you somewhere no one can bother me anymore.
: I want a quiet life where I feel safe because that is the only possible way I can counteract the way opening myself up feels. I can’t shake that, Sensei. I will never shake that.
: But if it’s you...and you really really love me...I’ll let it happen.
: I don’t just want you to let it happen, though...
: Neither do I, obviously! Do you know how much easier this would be if I could separate myself from all the fear and pain I associate with sex? I’d be a whole new girl.
: I’d be someone who could give you everything you wanted instead of a bunch of stuff you don’t want. And I’m sorry about that.

: I’m sorry you have to search for reasons to love me. I’m sorry that it wound up being me at all if...if what you were saying was even true back there and not just a lie you were using to try and fuck me.
: Do you really think I’d lie about that, Io?
: Yes.
: Just saying you love someone doesn’t mean it’s true. Because I’ve heard that ten million times and 99%% of those times were during the worst, most terrifying moments of my life.
: But I still believe in love despite that. I want this to be true. I just have no idea how to convince myself it is because I don’t know how love is supposed to look.

: You have an idea of that already. You’ve made up your mind on how love is supposed to be and feel and you shared that with me- but that didn’t feel like love to me, Sensei. So what am I supposed to do?
: How am I ever supposed to love anyone without getting a stomachache? Can I just knock myself out first? Would that do the trick? I have no idea where to go from here. I just...
: I know that I don’t want you to go away.
: You really hated it that much, huh?...
: Please don’t enable me to talk even more about how that made me feel when it’s a miracle you still like me in the first place.
: I don’t want to make those feelings dwindle even more than I’m sure they already have.
: Nothing’s dwindled, Io. I feel the same about you now that I did back then. And I wish I was different too.
: I can try, though. If you really hate it, I can try.
: No, because then that just makes me feel like you’re suffering for my sake and that sucks too. Just...
: I don’t know, Sensei. Maybe everything just felt worse back then because of what led into it. And while I’m not going to take back any of what I said, I do want to apologize for...how I said it.
: It’s just...that’s a...touchy subject for me.
: I would have avoided it altogether if I knew how bad it was beforehand. And I’m sorry too.
: Did you...enjoy it at least? Is that...okay for me to ask? Because I know I definitely didn’t help. And I can’t imagine finding out you’re playing with a broken toy is very-
: You need to stop that, Io.
: Huh?
: Saying you’re broken...
: So there’s...not really an easy or...comfortable way for me to say this, but...
: Thank you.
: You have somehow managed to make me like you even more. And if I couldn’t live without you before, I am perpetually fucked now. Just not literally. Which is exactly why I’m saying this.
: Uh...what?
: You left.
: You treated me like a...like a, like a person. And that...that...like...since I was going to do it and you just...you somehow, like...what?
: You could have done anything you wanted to me and you did nothing? At all? Did you...think I was going to tell on you? Did you only like me because you thought I was a virgin?
: Io-
: D-Don’t answer that question. Because I don’t want to know if you’re just not interested in me anymore so I can pretend it was something, like...somethiiiiing nice? You still like me, right?
: Am I just misinterpreting that whole exchange? Are you actually grossed out by me now? Because you should be. And now you’re probably just annoyed that I’m not over you yet or-
: Io, of course I’m still interested in you. I just wasn’t about to fuck you in the middle of a mental breakdown.
: Then...oh, okay. You want to do it now? Do I, like...owe you or something? How does this work?
: You’re asking if you owe me?
: Yeah, like...you just didn’t want to do it in the middle of an episode. But I’m fine now, so we can have sex if you want and you won’t feel guilty.
: No.
: So you don’t like me anymore then.
: Of course I like you.
: Just...not sexually?
: I mean, I definitely want to have sex with you.
: Then why won’t you?! I don’t understand! Did I do something wrong?! Are you phasing me out?! How am I supposed to interpret this, Sensei?!
: I just don’t want to make you do something you don’t want to do, that’s all.
: But this...this is like the thing. This is what you want. And you’re just going to deprive yourself of that because of the way I feel?
: Yeah. That pretty much hits the nail on the head.
: Are you an angel?...
: What?
: All of my life...I’ve been a tool.
: Am I...
: Actually free now?
: Yeah...I guess you are.
: Hah...
: How does it feel — finally being treated like a human after all this time?
: I don’t know...
: I’ve never felt like this before.
: Just because someone turned you into a tool doesn’t mean you are one, Io.
: Hah...
: I should have paid more attention to all of the hints you gave me. I never should have pressed you about what being a parent means to me. I should have protected you better than that.
: Protected me?...
: I was hanging off the edge of a cliff and you managed to pull me up. You didn’t just protect me...you saved my life. And you didn’t even get anything out of it...
: I don’t need to get anything. I just...understand what you’ve been through and I don’t want you to hurt any more than you already have.
: You’ve suffered more than enough for one lifetime, Io. You can rest now. I’m not going to hurt you.
: You...
: Back in my room, you said you went through something just like me, didn’t you? Is that why you can do this? Do you...actually get it?...
: Is that...okay for me to ask?
: I internalized my situation a little differently, I think.
: I’ll let you know whenever I figure that out.
: Do you want to get married?
: Io, come on.

: I mean it, Sensei! Right now! And that’s a huge deal coming from me since I think marriage as a concept is totally archaic and dumb and that putting labels on serious relationships is a recipe for disaster.
: But I’ll make an exception for you! I’ll do anything for you! And if that’s annoying, then...too bad! I’m not going anywhere! You fed the stray, now take responsibility!
: This is hardly the time nor the place for a proposal, but I’ll think about it.
: Pfft...hahahah!
: What the hell did a broken piece of shit like me ever do to deserve a teacher like you?
: Stop that.
: Huh?
: Saying you’re broken.
: It’s not your fault that any of this happened to you.
: I’m not going to stand here and say shit like “it’s all just a test” or “what doesn’t kill you makes you stronger,” though.
: You were dealt a terrible hand and forced to endure something no one should ever have to endure. I can’t fix that.
: And I don’t even like acknowledging it because it makes me feel worse about things that I have done.
: All I can do is love you. And it might not be the way you want or a way you’re used to, but it’s what I’ll do so long as you want me here.
: Do you want me here, though?...
: Are you absolutely sure that this is love?...
: I’m not sure anything is love when it really comes down to it...but I do know that I want you here.
: And I’m sorry that there’s only one way I know how to show you that.
: Don’t...worry about that. I have...ways of dealing with it.
: I’ll try to make it...less horrible for you in the future, though...
: But...do know that I’ll be...expecting a lot of cuddling once you’re done.
: Just maybe not...right away so I can have some time to, like...decompress?
: Does that...make sense?
: Nothing makes sense in this world, Io.
: It sucks that this had to be the one we were born into.
: Of course I want you here. I want to hold you as tight as I can and never let go.
: But all that will do is stop me from finding whatever it takes to make you feel even a fragment of the joy I feel when I look at you.
: C...Confusion is still probably the...main emotion I’m feeling right now, though. The joy is still there of course, just...you know...
: Not every day somebody...decides to not have sex with me.
: Well, your life is going to be pretty different from here on out then. Because I’m going to refuse having sex with you so many times that you’re going to start wanting it.
: Awwwww — that’s the least romantic thing anyone’s ever said to me.
: And also highly unlikely. But hey, life’s kind of like baseball. Sometimes, you get thrown a curve. Sometimes, you get thrown a fastball. And other times, Bartolo Colon hits a home run.
: Translation, please.
: You never know what’s going to happen next.
: And that’s kinda terrifying.
: But I guess it can be pretty exciting too.
Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!
Io’s affection has increased by 50!
